geographic_selection.pixel_selection: pixel-center inverse transform inside closed WGS84 bbox
geographic_selection.transform_operation: UTM zone 5N (with axis order normalized for visualization)

access.interpretation_limit: Bounded data access only; product QA, geospatial alignment, and scientific validity are not assessed.

display_transform.purpose: visualization only; raw product values are retained above
display_transform.stretch_method: 2nd to 98th percentile of display-eligible AOI samples

grid.coordinate_convention: pixel centers per GCOV product specification

interpretation_limits: One source observation only; no temporal change is measured.
Provider QA is displayed unchanged and does not authorize analysis.
Mask and exception flags use product-documented definitions; the display screen does not override provider QA.
No event, cause, damage, or ground condition is inferred from this layer.

input_data_exception_mask_attributes.description: Bitwise OR of input data exception codes for each image pixel (0: no anomaly, 2: NISAR LSAR qFSP-H1 sample slip). Also includes OR of validity mask bits, where each bit is set on for fully-focused data or off for partially focused or missing data (256:HH, 512:HV, 1024:VH, 2048:VV, 4096:LH, 8192:LV, 16384:RH, 32768:RV)
